              uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
              with:
                  cache: "pnpm"
                  node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
            - name: pnpm install, build, and test
              run: |
                  pnpm install
                  pnpm build
                  pnpm test

                  CI: true
                  COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.COVERALLS_REPO_TOKEN }}", "rationale": "The workflow runs install/build/test across a three-version Node matrix with no job timeout bound.
